submission_deadline.quote: Closing Date and Time: September 9, 2026 before 2:00:00 PM MT

questions_deadline.quote: Question Closing Time: September 2, 2026 before 2:00:00 PM MT

rfp_contact.quote: All questions shall be directed to: Olds College 4500 50 Street Olds, AB Purchasing Department purchasing@oldscollege.ca
rfp_contact.name: Purchasing Department

submission_method.quote: Proponents must submit an electronic copy by email. Submissions must be clearly marked with the Proponent’s name and address, the Proposal name and number and the Closing Date and Time.

contract_term.quote: Olds College will enter a contract for services for five (5) years. There will also be the opportunity to renew the contract for two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, based solely on the College’s discretion.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: Detailed LMS System Requirements. Functional Requirements - Student Experience and Quality Instruction. #1 Development & Management of Learning Content
scope_of_deliverables.value: The scope of deliverables includes a Learning Management System (LMS) platform with features such as development and management of learning content, assessment, and integration with external tools and systems, as outlined in Section D - Scope of Work & Pricing Schedule.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Proposals should be prepared concisely (edit as applicable: in 30 pages or less) and in the order below.
value: Acceptance of Service Agreement Terms and Conditions (Section C - Item 9)
All Proposals should have every page numbered in sequential order.
Completed Certification document - Section C Item 9 "Proposal Certification Document" must be completed in full and signed by the Proponent.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents shall submit pricing in their Proposal, as requested in Schedule D - Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule, as follows: ●​ in Canadian dollars, and ●​ Prices must remain fixed and applicable to all goods and services, as detailed within this RFP, throughout the entire term of the 5 year agreement.

insurance_requirements.quote: It is an Olds College requirement that for any Agreement entered into as a result of this RFP the Contractor shall, at its own expense and without limiting its obligations, provide and maintain policies of insurance as outlined below: ●​ Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence against third party claims for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage (including loss of use thereof).

references_required.quote: Proponents should provide three references, where their company has provided the goods and services similar to those outlined in this RFP, including: ●​ name and title; ●​ name of company; ●​ phone number and email address; ●​ types of goods and services provided; and ●​ duration and value of agreement.

data_security_requirements.quote: ●​ Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information ●​ Safeguards against data breaches ●​ Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA)
value: adherence to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA)

data_hosting_residency.quote: ●​ Providing an LMS in a cloud-based, rather than on-premise, platform ●​ Preference will be given to a Canadian host location

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: RFP Evaluations & product demos September 10 - November 15, 2026
